transactioncolumncustomfield.description: Ticked when this line is cut to a length before shipping. Priced as its own service: $0.20 per board foot, charged in ADDITION to planing when both apply on one line (Marc-Antoine Poirier, 2026-08-21 - "0.20$ pour chacun des services ... coupe + planage ... 0.40/bf"). Like planing, it creates no new SKU and no inventory adjustment.
transactioncolumncustomfield.help: Tick this when the line is cut to length. Enter the target length alongside. Costed at $0.20 per board foot, on top of planing if the line is also planed.
